scenicChapters.title: Salta → Cuesta del Obispo
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 143 km. 3348 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Cuesta del Obispo → Cachi
scenicChapters.narrative: 3348 m come off over 83 km at around 7.8%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

valles-calchaquies-salta-cachi.story: 226 km from Salta to Cachí, about 3 h 07 of riding. The highest point is about 3,600 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
